script.title: John Madden's Thanksgiving prize: up to 8 turkey drumsticks
sentences: Coach John Madden's Thanksgiving prize had up to eight drumsticks.
He coached the Oakland Raiders to a Super Bowl and never had a losing season.
Then came thirty years calling games on TV, and he got around by bus.
Every Thanksgiving, the winning team got a turkey.
Each winning player got a drumstick.
So out came a nuclear turkey with as many as eight.
It was his odd take on a player of the game award.
Since 2022, the NFL has called its Thanksgiving tripleheader the John Madden Thanksgiving Celebration.
Not bad for a man handing out turkey legs.
script.description:
Before the new Madden movie, there was the nuclear turkey.
The coach who turned Thanksgiving football into a drumstick ceremony.
claims_en: John Madden awarded a turkey drumstick to winning players after the Thanksgiving Day game, often bringing out a 'nuclear turkey' with as many as eight drumsticks
He was head coach of the Oakland Raiders (1969-1978) and won Super Bowl XI
He never had a losing season as a head coach
He was an NFL color commentator from 1979 to 2009 (thirty years)
He would award a turkey or turducken to the winning team
The drumsticks served as an odd take on the player of the game award
Beginning in 2022 the NFL's entire Thanksgiving tripleheader was dubbed the John Madden Thanksgiving Celebration
